title: A Principled Framework for Evaluating on Typologically Diverse Languages

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates the typological diversity of language samples used in multilingual NLP benchmarks using features from the Grambank database. It compares performance estimates (accuracy for topic classification, BLEU for machine translation, and subword fertility for tokenization) derived from commonly used 'convenience' samples against those from systematically sampled typologically diverse sets to demonstrate how sampling bias leads to overestimated generalizability.
